feature: Data Model Enhancements for Multi-Provider Support
story: Define Core Provider and Model Types
story_description: As a developer, I need strongly-typed enums and structs representing AI providers, models, and tiers so that the codebase can safely route sessions to the correct CLI adapter and display accurate provider metadata in the UI.
task: Implement AIProvider, AIModel, ModelTier, and DirectorySource Types
task_description: Create the foundational Swift types (AIProvider enum, AIModel struct, ModelTier enum, DirectorySource enum) that represent provider metadata, model capabilities, and session initialization options. These types enable the harness to route sessions to the correct CLI adapter and display provider-specific branding.
atom_description: Add AIProvider enum (anthropic, openai, google, community), AIModel struct with full metadata (context window, costs, capabilities), ModelTier enum (flagship, balanced, fast), DirectorySource enum (browse, clone, create), and AIModelRegistry static lookup. Extend Session model with provider and modelId fields. Add database migration v7 for new columns.
problem_statement: The Session model currently lacks provider and model association fields needed for multi-CLI support. Without these, the harness cannot determine which CLI adapter to use, which model-specific CLI flags to pass, or which provider branding to display. This atom creates the type-safe foundation for the entire multi-engine architecture.

notes: This atom is the foundation for all multi-CLI support. AIProvider and AIModel types are referenced by SessionCreationWizard, EngineAdapter, and UI components. The static registry approach is intentional to avoid network calls during session creation; dynamic registry fetching is deferred to F006.
